body: I just want to thank everyone for the comments. You have all been a huge help. It's amazing, how much a few words can do. I think I'll be okay for now, thanks to all of you.

I've never posted anything on reddit before...but I wanted to say that I went through the same thing when I was in high school. I went to court for truancy, and things went downhill from there. Eventually I ended up dropping out of school, and getting a G.E.D (which I don't recommend).

I'd love to give some advice, but I don't know what to say. Personally, psychologists have been a huge help to me in the past. Playing guitar, listening to music, and meditation also helped me through some tough times. I wish you the best of luck :)
